mapper.select: SELECT cni.id, cni.item_id, cni.customer_id, cni.level_id, cni.nurse_number, cni.is_deleted, cni.buy_time, cni.maturity_time, c.customer_name, nc.serial_number, nc.nursing_name, nc.service_price FROM customernurseitem cni JOIN customer c ON (cni.customer_id = c.id) JOIN nursecontent nc ON (cni.item_id = nc.id) WHERE cni.is_deleted = 0 AND cni.customer_id = #{customerId}
